description.p: UniDB is a native database studio for Linux built with GTK4 and libadwaita.

ul.li: Connect to SQLite, PostgreSQL, CockroachDB, MySQL, MariaDB, Redis, MongoDB, Cassandra, and MSSQL.
Browse databases and tables with lazy loading.
Write and run SQL in a syntax highlighted editor with a result grid.
Design tables with a DDL preview and transactional apply.
Import and export CSV and JSON with reports.
Search history, save queries, and choose a light or dark theme.

description.p: First packaged build with the shell, connections, navigator, editor, table designer, transfer, and history.
